answer: The OCBC 365 card has a monthly cashback cap of S$250, with no category limits.

sources.title: OCBC 365 Credit Card: features, fees and eligibility
sources.excerpt:
- Minimum spend of S$800 per calendar month to earn the 6% rate. If it is not met, the 0.25% base rate applies.
- Total cashback is capped at S$160 per month from 1 November 2026, with no separate category caps.

sources.title: OCBC 365 Credit Card: features, fees and eligibility
sources.excerpt:
- 5% cashback on dining.
- 3% cashback on groceries, land transport, recurring telco and electricity bills, and streaming.
- 6% cashback on petrol.
- 0.25% base cashback on other eligible transactions.

sources.title: OCBC 365 Credit Card: features, fees and eligibility
sources.excerpt:
- 6% cashback on dining (including fast food), groceries, land transport and petrol, in Singapore and overseas.
- 3% cashback at Watsons until 31 March 2027; 0.25% from 1 April 2027.
- Up to 1% cashback on eligible advertising platform spend (1% with full payment, 0.5% with instalments).
- 0.25% base cashback on other eligible transactions.

sources.title: Terms and conditions governing OCBC 365 Credit Card Cashback Programme
sources.excerpt:
- 2A(a): 6% cashback on "Dining", "Groceries", "Land Transport" and "Petrol", subject to the Minimum Spend Requirement.
- 2A(b): 3% cashback on "Watsons" (valid till 31 March 2027), subject to the Minimum Spend Requirement.
- 2B: 0.25% cashback on all card transactions if the Minimum Spend Requirement is not met, and on transactions outside Clause 2A if it is met.
- 2C: 1% cashback on "Advertising Platform" with full payment.
- 2D: 0.5% cashback on "Advertising Platform" with payment in instalments.
